title: N8N Workflow Automation - 99% Autonomous Solution
key_finding: N8N workflow activation requires UI or server CLI - this is a security feature, not a limitation

solution.approach: Accept one-time 30-second manual step, automate everything else
solution.manual_steps: One-time 30-second UI toggle per new workflow

workflow_deployment.notes: Auto-detects existing, updates or creates, strips read-only properties

knowledge_ingestion.notes: Fully automated after workflow is active

status_monitoring.notes: Returns full workflow details including active status

recurring_updates.script: Can be fully scripted/cron after initial activation

workflow_activation.alternative: SSH to server + n8n CLI (if server access available)

pragmatic_decision.accept: N8N security model requires UI/CLI for activation
pragmatic_decision.crew_consensus: Acceptable - focus automation on high-frequency tasks

monthly_knowledge_update: 1. Run: automated script (organizes docs, ingests, prunes)

ssh_automation_option.requirement: SSH key added to n8n server

current_workflow.name: Alex AI Knowledge Base RAG Ingestion

after_activation.result: All DDD knowledge searchable in Supabase

crew_reminder: For new N8N workflows: Deploy is automated ✅, activation needs 30-sec UI toggle (one-time), then ingestion is automated ✅ forever. This is acceptable and pragmatic.
based_on: Real N8N API testing, web research, pragmatic engineering decisions
